openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: The Ubiquiti U6 Long Range (U6-LR) is a PoE powered 802.11ax WiFi 6 access point with 8 spacial streams. The design is approximately a 9" (220mm) disk designed for wall mounting or can be layed flat on a shelf.
openwrt_wiki.Supported Versions: Devices with manufacturing date 2234 (34rd week of 2022) and later appear to be a version 3 hardware with a different (1 GbE only) Ethernet PHY chip. Flashing v2 firmware to this hardware will result in inoperable Ethernet.
openwrt_wiki.v1 vs v2: Two versions, v1 and v2, are not official names and thus not found in official Ubiquiti documents. Difference between two versions is that v1's LED has full RGB color support while v2's has limited blue/white colors, due to supply shortages. [...] installing a v1 firmware on a v2 device is not fatal, just getting an error message around LED device initialization.
openwrt_wiki.v3: Since about summer 2022 there is a v3 device with a RTL8211 PHY. The v3 is not compatible with v1/v2 images. Use a v3 image (since 23.05). PHY-Tabelle: AQR112C = v2, RTL8211 = v3. Note: as of early 2024, it appears that both v2 and v3 are in production.
openwrt_wiki.Installation (gekürzt): Werksreset (Reset ~10 s bis LED blinkt); Stock-Firmware per DHCP oder 192.168.1.20 (alt 192.168.1.34), SSH ubnt/ubnt; Version per dmesg prüfen; sysupgrade-Image per SCP übertragen, bootselect auf kernel0, Image nach kernel0 und kernel1 schreiben, Neustart; erster Start ca. 4 min, danach LED dauerhaft blau. Danach 192.168.1.1/24, DHCP-Server auf LAN, WLAN aus.
openwrt_wiki.MAC-Adresse: on the rear panel of the device (middle line next to the QR code - combination of small and large font), and also encoded in the QR code (first line of encoded text)
openwrt_wiki.U-Boot mod: Alternative Images (ubootmod) mit eigenem Preloader/U-Boot/Recovery-Partition; nicht mit Standard-Images mischen
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout (Stock): mtd0 Preloader 0x40000, mtd1 ATF 0x20000, mtd2 u-boot 0x60000, mtd3 u-boot-env 0x10000, mtd4 Factory 0x40000, mtd5 EEPROM 0x10000, mtd6 bs 0x10000, mtd7 cfg 0x100000, mtd8 kernel0 0x1ee0000, mtd9 kernel1 0x1ee0000
openwrt_wiki.Debricking: Stock-Firmware per TFTP: PoE trennen, Reset gedrückt halten, PoE wieder anstecken, 15-20 s halten bis LED weiß-blau-aus wechselt; IP des Geräts per ARP-Scan suchen (nicht immer 192.168.1.20, reagiert evtl. nicht auf Ping); Datei firmware.bin per TFTP senden; 5-10 min warten
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: glued together; heat gun ~90 °C on outer border, knife under the ethernet port, then flat screwdriver around; plastic clips break easily
openwrt_wiki.Serial: CPU UART0 at the pinout next to the Holtek MCU. Pinout (first pin next to SoC / MCU): 0 3V3, 1 RX, 2 TX, 3 GND. 115200, 8N1
